title: Prove a moving-frame ternary COPY floor of 14 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped mathematical proof with an exact finite certificate. Every factorization of the thirteen-line ternary Gram matrix into at most four scalar outer products has full-orthogonality binary COPY cost at least **14**, over every characteristic-zero field, with arbitrary moving frames and coefficients. This settles Aaron Wang / navinor's merged [PR2518](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2518), Open next question 2, in the negative.

```text
13 projective ternary ports
  -> 25 intersection directions
  -> complete restriction-rank envelope
  -> every <=4-term decoder costs >=14
```

The exact minimum with at most four terms lies between 14 and 18. No attainment at 14, physical decoder, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. The first verified improvement ended the mathematical work.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Aaron Wang / PR2518 and PR2272 for the open question and contract; DreamingOfClouds / PR2125, PR2228, PR2111, PR446, PR595 and PR1590 for the COPY/polar-law model; Cinna Davis / PR2240 for the fixed-frame one-extra family; and joaqcoo / PR1224 for the one-sided factorization context. Classical rank factorization, projective intersections and elimination retain their credit. No predecessor census or scientific result is audited or replayed.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362906). Base canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030; the submission refresh retained that base.

## Evidence

- Before, PR2518 excluded a fixed-frame one-extra family and explicitly left unrestricted four-term moving frames open. After, the new proof forces one factor side into the evaluation code and combines its full support-rank envelope with the thirteen pairwise nonproportional Gram columns.
- Both binary eliminations agree on all **204,800** direction/subset restrictions. All **28,561** ordered support-size tuples are enumerated, including **22,856** satisfying the necessary support-mass condition. The relaxed minimum is 14; its size witness is not asserted to be a decoder.
- Seven exact factorization fixtures include rank-four outside-code factor sides and transposed cases. Seven semantic rejection controls pass. The coordinate fixture attains the three-term cost 18.
- CPython **3.12.15**, macOS, standard library only. Warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks pass, timed locally at **4.703 s** and **4.887 s**. Both are below their individual 120-second registered limits. These are check durations, not performance comparisons.
- Registered replay and metadata/pins pass, including a fresh replay of the committed package. Committed-byte and declared-source-history checks pass for all six files at `bc7318ee294fb3b94342996651ea544c89450223`. AST compilation and staged whitespace checks pass. Ruff was unavailable.
- The official six-file committed export passes integrity and declared-input coverage. Its optimized direct replay also passes in a Git-free directory.
- The selected binding baseline passed for orientation. Its supplier was not scientifically replayed.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/ternary-moving-frame-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/ternary-moving-frame-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ternary-moving-frame-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/ternary-moving-frame-floor --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the local absolute path. Expected direct marker: `PASS_TERNARY_MOVING_FRAME_FLOOR four_term_cost>=14 three_term_cost>=18`. The verifier writes nothing and prints a generated receipt binding the six package files by SHA256.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The pairing, thirteen ports, characteristic zero and at-most-four-term hypotheses define the scope. Changed pairings, masked identities, shared-copy tariffs and five or more active terms are not excluded. The coefficient space is covered by the written reduction; the finite replay certifies the restriction-rank premise rather than enumerating all coefficient tuples.

Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Physical delivery, native implementation, dirty restoration, ownership, routing, compiler closure, precision, stock, BIT compatibility and the complete outer bill remain unpriced. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed.

## Open next questions

- Determine the exact minimum with at most four terms between 14 and 18. Start with a complete factorization costing 14 through 17; simultaneous realizability of the relaxed support patterns is the blocker.
- Can five terms beat thirteen with this pairing? Start with two rank-four factor spaces whose product has rank three. The present forced-code-side argument does not cover them.

## Related open work

The completion refresh inspected this account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. No additional PR computing this thirteen-port Gram matrix's unrestricted four-term COPY minimum was identified, and no shared-instance numerical disagreement was found.

- [PR6471](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6471) proves minimum block fitting rank under compatible port flags for arbitrary directed masks. This package fixes a scalar Gram identity and charges per-term binary support ranks; the optimization quantity and tariff differ, and no common-instance number is computed.
- [PR6387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6387) concerns ternary dyadic numerator denominators for 3-by-3 identity decompositions, a different coefficient and cost contract.

PR2518 and PR2272 are merged predecessors. Sparse notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain overlap limits. No extra computations checked another PR's numbers.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** isolated.

Six new files under `research/ternary-moving-frame-floor/`. Frozen sources, shared code and the selected result are unchanged. Archive retention would not establish supplier admission.
